title: Model a closed rectangular wall footprint and confirm its corners are allowed to join
task: Create four walls forming a closed rectangular loop on a level, then confirm that each wall's ends are allowed to join at the corners. Use WallUtils to check joins, not JoinGeometryUtils.

miss.surfaced: mostly BuiltInParameter and PostableCommand noise; JoinGeometryUtils did not appear

pitfalls.symptom: JoinGeometryUtils.AreElementsJoined returns false for freshly created walls that visibly meet at their corners, so the task looks failed.
pitfalls.cause: AreElementsJoined reports geometry joins (the Join Geometry command's effect), which newly created walls do not have; wall-end joins are a different mechanism.
pitfalls.fix: Ask WallUtils.IsWallJoinAllowedAtEnd(wall, 0) and (wall, 1) for each wall; that is what 'do the corners join' means for walls.
